UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -euo pipefail; root='{{$FullRootDir}}'; if [ -x \"$root/dotnet/dotnet\" ] && \"$root/dotnet/dotnet\" --list-runtimes | grep -q '^Microsoft.NETCore.App 10\.'; then echo '[AMP] .NET 10 runtime already installed'; else tmp=\"$(mktemp)\"; curl -fsSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh -o \"$tmp\"; bash \"$tmp\" --channel 10.0 --runtime dotnet --install-dir \"$root/dotnet\" --no-path; rm -f \"$tmp\"; fi"

-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $root='{{$FullRootDir}}'; $dotnet=Join-Path $root 'dotnet\dotnet.exe'; $ready=$false; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dotnet) { $ready=[bool]((& $dotnet --list-runtimes) -match '^Microsoft.NETCore.App 10\.') }; if ($ready) { Write-Output '[AMP] .NET 10 runtime already installed' } else { $script=Join-Path $env:TEMP ('dotnet-install-'+[guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')+'.ps1'); try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.ps1 -OutFile $script; & $script -Channel 10.0 -Runtime dotnet -InstallDir (Join-Path $root 'dotnet') -NoPath } finally { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $script -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }"

-c "set -euo pipefail; root='{{$FullRootDir}}'; tag='{{StratumVersionTag}}'; if [ -z \"$tag\" ]; then tag=\"$(curl -fsSL -H 'User-Agent: AMP-Clean-Template' https://api.github.com/repos/StratumServer/Stratum/releases/latest | jq -r .tag_name)\"; fi; case \"$tag\" in v*) ;; *) tag=\"v$tag\";; esac; version=\"${tag#v}\"; asset=\"stratum-${version}-linux-x64.zip\"; stage=\"$root/.amp-stratum-stage\"; archive=\"$root/.amp-stratum.zip\"; rm -rf \"$stage\"; mkdir -p \"$stage\"; curl -fL --retry 3 -o \"$archive\" \"https://github.com/StratumServer/Stratum/releases/download/$tag/$asset\"; unzip -q \"$archive\" -d \"$stage\"; rm -f \"$archive\"; test -x \"$stage/StratumServer\" || chmod +x \"$stage/StratumServer\"; test -x \"$stage/StratumServer\"; old=\"$root/.amp-stratum-old\"; rm -rf \"$old\"; if [ -d \"$root/server\" ]; then mv \"$root/server\" \"$old\"; fi; mv \"$stage\" \"$root/server\"; rm -rf \"$old\"; printf '%s' \"$tag\" > \"$root/server/.amp-stratum-release\""

-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $root='{{$FullRootDir}}'; $tag='{{StratumVersionTag}}'.Trim(); $headers=@{'User-Agent'='AMP-Clean-Template'}; if (-not $tag) { $tag=(Invoke-RestMethod -Headers $headers -Uri https://api.github.com/repos/StratumServer/Stratum/releases/latest).tag_name }; if (-not $tag.StartsWith('v')) { $tag='v'+$tag }; $version=$tag.TrimStart('v'); $asset='stratum-'+$version+'-win-x64.zip'; $stage=Join-Path $root '.amp-stratum-stage'; $archive=Join-Path $root '.amp-stratum.zip'; $server=Join-Path $root 'server'; $old=Join-Path $root '.amp-stratum-old'; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $stage,$old,$archive -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $stage | Out-Null; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Headers $headers -Uri ('https://github.com/StratumServer/Stratum/releases/download/'+$tag+'/'+$asset) -OutFile $archive; Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $archive -DestinationPath $stage -Force; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $archive -Force; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $stage 'StratumServer.exe'))) { throw 'Stratum archive did not contain StratumServer.exe' }; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $server) { Move-Item -LiteralPath $server -Destination $old }; try { Move-Item -LiteralPath $stage -Destination $server; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $old -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch { if ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $old) -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $server)) { Move-Item -LiteralPath $old -Destination $server }; throw }; [IO.File]::WriteAllText((Join-Path $server '.amp-stratum-release'),$tag,(New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding $false))"

#!/bin/sh
set -eu

fail() {
    printf '%s\n' "[AMP World] ERROR: $*" >&2
    exit 1
}

[ "$#" -eq 1 ] || fail 'usage: apply-world-settings.sh INSTANCE_ROOT'
command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'jq is required'
command -v realpath >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'realpath is required'

root=$(realpath -m "$1")
data="$root/data"
managed="$data/amp-world-settings.json"
contract="$data/amp-world-settings-contract.json"
config="$data/serverconfig.json"
state="$data/amp-world-settings-state.json"
backup="$data/serverconfig.json.amp-world-backup"

[ -f "$managed" ] || fail "AMP world settings do not exist: $managed"
[ -f "$contract" ] || fail "AMP world settings contract does not exist: $contract"
[ -f "$config" ] || fail "Vintage Story serverconfig does not exist: $config"

jq empty "$managed" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'AMP world settings are not valid JSON'
jq empty "$contract" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'AMP world settings contract is not valid JSON'
jq empty "$config" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'Vintage Story serverconfig is not valid JSON'

jq -e --slurpfile c "$contract" '
  . as $m |
  ($m.SchemaVersion == 1) and
  (($m.ApplyToExistingWorld | type) == "boolean") and
  (($c[0] | type) == "array") and (($c[0] | length) == 68) and
  all($c[0][];
    . as $e |
    ($m | has($e.Group)) and ($m[$e.Group] | has($e.Key)) and
    ($m[$e.Group][$e.Key] as $v |
      (($e.Type == "string" and ($v | type) == "string") or
       ($e.Type == "boolean" and ($v | type) == "boolean") or
       ($e.Type == "integer" and ($v | type) == "number" and ($v | floor) == $v) or
       ($e.Type == "number" and ($v | type) == "number")) and
      (($e | has("Allowed") | not) or (($e.Allowed | index($v)) != null)) and
      (($e | has("MaxLength") | not) or (($v | length) <= $e.MaxLength))))
' "$managed" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'managed settings failed schema, type, or allowed-value validation'

save_location=$(jq -er '.WorldConfig.SaveFileLocation | select(type == "string" and length > 0)' "$config") || fail 'WorldConfig.SaveFileLocation is blank or missing'
server_root=$(realpath -m "$root/server")
data_root=$(realpath -m "$data")
case "$save_location" in
    /*) save_path=$(realpath -m "$save_location") ;;
    *)
        save_path=$(realpath -m "$server_root/$save_location")
        case "$save_path" in
            "$data_root"/*) ;;
            *) fail "relative SaveFileLocation escapes the instance data directory: $save_location" ;;
        esac
        ;;
esac

if [ -f "$save_path" ]; then existing=true; else existing=false; fi
enforce=$(jq -r '.ApplyToExistingWorld' "$managed")

rendered=$(mktemp "$data/.serverconfig.json.tmp.XXXXXX")
next_rendered=$(mktemp "$data/.serverconfig.json.next.XXXXXX")
previous_commands=$(mktemp "$data/.amp-world-previous.XXXXXX")
managed_commands=$(mktemp "$data/.amp-world-commands.XXXXXX")
state_temp=$(mktemp "$data/.amp-world-state.XXXXXX")
cleanup() {
    rm -f "$rendered" "$next_rendered" "$previous_commands" "$managed_commands" "$state_temp"
}
trap cleanup EXIT HUP INT TERM

jq -S --slurpfile m "$managed" --slurpfile c "$contract" '
  reduce ($c[0][] | select(.Group == "Server")) as $e
    (. ; setpath(($e.CreationPath | split(".")); $m[0][$e.Group][$e.Key]))
' "$config" > "$rendered" || fail 'could not render server settings'

if [ "$existing" = false ]; then
    jq -S --slurpfile m "$managed" --slurpfile c "$contract" '
      .WorldConfig.WorldConfiguration = {} |
      reduce ($c[0][] | select(.Group != "Server")) as $e
        (. ; setpath(
          ($e.CreationPath | split("."));
          (if $e.Group == "Creation" and $e.Key == "Seed" and $m[0][$e.Group][$e.Key] == ""
           then null else $m[0][$e.Group][$e.Key] end)
        ))
    ' "$rendered" > "$next_rendered" || fail 'could not render new-world settings'
    mv -f "$next_rendered" "$rendered"
    printf '[]\n' > "$managed_commands"
else
    if [ -f "$state" ]; then
        if jq -e '.SchemaVersion == 1 and (.ManagedCommands | type) == "array" and all(.ManagedCommands[]; type == "string")' "$state" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            jq -c '.ManagedCommands' "$state" > "$previous_commands"
        else
            printf '%s\n' '[AMP World] WARNING: state file invalid; preserving all existing startup commands' >&2
            printf '[]\n' > "$previous_commands"
        fi
    else
        printf '[]\n' > "$previous_commands"
    fi

    if [ "$enforce" = true ]; then
        jq -c -n --slurpfile m "$managed" --slurpfile c "$contract" '
          [$c[0][] | select(.Lifecycle == "restart" or .Lifecycle == "unexplored" or .Lifecycle == "server") |
            . as $e | ($m[0][$e.Group][$e.Key] | tostring) as $value |
            (if $e.Lifecycle == "server" then "/serverconfig " else "/worldconfig " end) + $e.Command + " " + $value]
        ' > "$managed_commands" || fail 'could not generate managed startup commands'
    else
        printf '[]\n' > "$managed_commands"
    fi

    jq -S --slurpfile old "$previous_commands" --slurpfile managed "$managed_commands" '
      ((.StartupCommands // "") | split("\n") | map(sub("\r$"; "")) |
       map(select(length > 0)) | map(. as $line | select(($old[0] | index($line)) == null))) as $custom |
      .StartupCommands = (($custom + $managed[0]) | join("\n"))
    ' "$rendered" > "$next_rendered" || fail 'could not reconcile startup commands'
    mv -f "$next_rendered" "$rendered"
    jq -S -n --slurpfile commands "$managed_commands" '{SchemaVersion:1, ManagedCommands:$commands[0]}' > "$state_temp" || fail 'could not render managed state'
fi

jq empty "$rendered" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'rendered serverconfig failed JSON validation'
if [ "$existing" = true ]; then jq empty "$state_temp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'rendered state failed JSON validation'; fi

changed=false
if ! cmp -s "$rendered" "$config"; then
    cp -p "$config" "$backup" || fail 'could not create serverconfig.json.amp-world-backup'
    mv -f "$rendered" "$config" || fail 'could not atomically replace serverconfig.json'
    changed=true
fi

if [ "$existing" = true ]; then
    if [ ! -f "$state" ] || ! cmp -s "$state_temp" "$state"; then
        if ! mv -f "$state_temp" "$state"; then
            if [ "$changed" = true ] && [ -f "$backup" ]; then
                rollback=$(mktemp "$data/.serverconfig.rollback.XXXXXX")
                cp -p "$backup" "$rollback" && mv -f "$rollback" "$config"
            fi
            fail 'could not atomically replace AMP world settings state'
        fi
    fi
fi

command_count=$(jq -r 'length' "$managed_commands")
if [ "$existing" = true ]; then creation_count=0; mode=existing; else creation_count=68; mode=new; fi
printf '%s\n' "[AMP World] save=$mode enforcement=$enforce creation-values=$creation_count managed-commands=$command_count"
if [ "$existing" = true ] && [ "$enforce" = true ]; then
    printf '%s\n' '[AMP World] WARNING: world-generation overrides affect only unexplored chunks and may create visible terrain borders' >&2
fi
